Product Description

Manufactured from Stainless Steel 316 and features precision gear profiles produced entirely on a CNC machining center, eliminating the need for dedicated gear-cutting tooling due to low production volumes. The process demonstrates advanced manufacturing capability, combining complex profile generation, tight dimensional control, and superior surface finish in a corrosion-resistant material known for its machining challenges.

Specialised programming, optimized cutting parameters, and skilled process planning ensured accurate tooth geometry and consistent quality. This approach highlights our expertise in low-volume, high precision manufacturing, enabling cost-effective production of intricate components while maintaining stringent engineering and performance requirements.
